statement.p: Compute the derivative of the given function. f(t) = \sqrt[3]{t}(\sec t - 3 e^{0.6 t}).

static.solution:
Solution:
Use the Product Rule. \begin{array}{rcl} f'(t) \amp =\amp \displaystyle \sqrt[3]{t} \frac{d}{dx}[ \sec t - 3 e^{0.6 t} ] + \frac{d}{dx}[\sqrt[3]{t}] (\sec t - 3 e^{0.6 t}) \\ \amp \amp \\ \amp =\amp \displaystyle \sqrt[3]{t} (\sec t \tan t - 1.8 e^{0.6 t}) + \frac{1}{3}t^{-2/3} (\sec t - 3 e^{0.6 t}) \end{array}
